narr: An upper level low pressure area with very cold temperatures aloft moved towards South FL today through the day. This along with strong daytime heating and high atmospheric moisture led to rounds of strong to severe showers and thunderstorms areawide. Strong wind gusts, flooding, and hazardous marine conditions were the main impacts across the South FL local waters.
ev: Various reports of flooding in Miami Beach reported via an off duty NWS meteorologist and the public via social media. Water was reported to exceed curbs on Collins Avenue, significant street flooding occurring with water above curbs and halfway up vehicle tires, reports of water entering buildings at Collins Avenue and 41st Street, and water halfway up vehicle tires near 86th Street and Harding Avenue.
lsr: SOCIAL MEDIA REPORT OF WATER BEGINNING TO ENTER BUSINESSES AT COLLINS AND 41ST STREET. WATER ALSO UP HALFWAY TIRES OF PASSING VEHICLES.
